text:
marie: Quick q on onboarding 'Lumen-7B-v0.9' — license attached says 'non-commercial research only, must attribute, no redistribution of weights'. Can we host quantized variant for Dedicated customers or ship quantized weights for Private installs? :thinking_face:
ajay: pinging legal. do you have the model card + license link?
marie: pasted snippet:
```
LICENSE: Non-Commercial Research License v1.0
You may use the model for research and internal evaluation. Redistribution of model weights or derivatives is prohibited. Attribution required in product UI: "Model: Lumen-7B (LumenAI)."
```
ajay: ok first pass: explicit redistribution prohibition means we cannot provide downloadable weights to customers. Hosting inference in Redwood Hosted is fine if license allows service usage — but it's NC, so commercial hosted usage would be prohibited. For Dedicated, it's trickier: if customer buys reserved capacity from us that runs the model for their internal product, that may be allowed if it's internal research only. Need legal review with license owner. :eyes:
olivia: on quality side, quantization doesn't change copyright but counts as derivative. so still prohibited to distribute quantized files. also need to confirm whether the required attribution is just in docs or must be visible in the product UI (API responses vs front-end).
ryan: partner ops here — customers often ask for weights for air-gapped installs. without redistribution permission we can't hand them binaries. we should prepare an outreach template asking for carve-outs (hosted + quantized distribution) and clarify attribution placement.
marie: we have a contact at LumenAI, emailed earlier but no reply. i'll paste the contact email and cc legal when i follow up.
ajay: i'll draft a short permission request. key asks: (1) permission to serve a quantized variant for Dedicated/private (not public redistrib), (2) permission to distribute quantized weights to enterprise customers under NDA/CLA, (3) exact attribution text and placement requirements.
license-bot: License scan summary for Lumen-7B-v0.9: license_type=non-commercial, redistribution=forbidden, attribution=required (UI), contact_required=true
marie: thanks — we'll hold on any external bench publish or artifact uploads. internal evals still allowed.
olivia: for evals: we can run 4-bit quant locally on our infra and compare Llama, Falcon baselines, but artifacts and weight dumps stay on internal network. i'll also freeze any perf numbers until legal sign-off if we plan to show benchmarks externally.
ajay: once we get written confirmation, we'll add a short note to the model onboarding doc and a checkbox to the release checklist: "redistribution carve-out obtained?"
ryan: i can add outreach template to sales-templates and vendor-requests so onboarding/sales use same wording.
marie: i'll follow up here as soon as i hear back. tagging @ajay @olivia @ryan for awareness. :thumbsup:
